subject: maned wolf
title: South America's Tallest Wild Dog Eats Fruit for Half Its Diet

scenes.text: The tallest wild dog on Earth gets half its food from fruit.
The maned wolf stands three feet at the shoulder on long, stilt-like legs.
It hunts rodents and birds, but about half of what it eats is plants.
Its favorite is a tomato-like fruit called the wolf apple.
And its pee smells so much like cannabis that police were once called to a Dutch zoo.
The suspect was in the wolf enclosure. Literally.

description:
The maned wolf of South America stands about 3 feet at the shoulder, and fruit and plants make up about half its diet, especially the wolf apple (lobeira).
Its urine contains a chemical that smells like hops or cannabis; at Rotterdam Zoo, police were called over a suspected marijuana smoker, and it was the wolves.
Would you have guessed a wolf eats fruit?
first_comment: Despite the name it isn't a wolf or a fox; it's in its own genus. What animal name is the most misleading?
